hotspots.title: Fuel Economy Standards Rollback
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration is pushing through a dramatic reduction in fuel‑efficiency standards for cars and trucks, cutting projected MPG by nearly a third. The move is framed as a cost‑saving measure while opponents warn of higher emissions and climate backsliding.
hotspots.affect: The story ignites fierce partisan clashes over climate policy, economic impacts, and regulatory overreach, generating heated commentary across outlets.
